title: NCUC Docket E-100, SUB 158 — Order Granting Extension Of Time To Serve Proposed Record On Appeal
text:
STATE OF NORTH CAROLINA 
UTILITIES COMMISSION 
RALEIGH 
DOCKET NO. E-100, SUB 158 
BEFORE THE NORTH CAROLINA UTILITIES COMMISSION 
In the Matter of 
Biennial Determination of Avoided Cost 
Rates for Electric Utility Purchases from 
Qualifying Facilities – 2018 
) 
) 
) 
ORDER GRANTING EXTENSION 
OF TIME TO SERVE PROPOSED 
RECORD ON APPEAL 
BY THE CHAIR: On September 17, 2020, the North Carolina Sustainable Energy 
Association and the North Carolina Clean Energy Business Alliance (Appellants), 
pursuant to Rules 18 and 27 of the North Carolina Rules of Appellate Procedure, filed a 
joint motion for a 30-day extension of time to serve the proposed record on appeal in this 
matter. Appellants state that additional time is required to prepare and serve the proposed 
record due to other workload of the attorneys involved in the case, including responding 
to the motion to dismiss appeal filed in this proceeding; the complexity of the issues; and 
the large record. Appellants further state they communicated with counsel for the parties 
to this proceeding and that no party has indicated that it objects to this request. 
The Chair, therefore, finds good cause to grant the requested extension of time for 
Appellants to serve the proposed record on appeal. 
IT IS, THEREFORE, SO ORDERED. 
ISSUED BY ORDER OF THE COMMISSION. 
This the 28th day of September, 2020. 

NORTH CAROLINA UTILITIES COMMISSION 

Janice H. Fulmore, Deputy Clerk
